name: Findings popover is scoped to the hovered severity chip
description:
Hovering a severity chip in the run timeline opens the FindingsPopover filtered to that severity, titled '<n> <SEVERITY> FINDING(S) IN THIS RUN'.

Targets PR #479 (not #482) on purpose: #479 carries the same 1 CRITICAL + 2 WARNING + 1 SUGGESTION distribution, but it has exactly ONE agent run and one review accordion, so every selector below resolves to a single node. #482 seeds three runs and is a noisier surface for the same assertions.

Locators: the chips are the only nodes carrying `data-severity`, which makes them the one severity locator that cannot collide with the uppercase tally pills or the title-case filter buttons — `find text` is case-INSENSITIVE, so text locators cannot tell those three apart.

Titles are asserted UPPERCASE because the panel header is text-transform: uppercase and `wait --text` matches rendered text case-SENSITIVELY.

Severity scope is deliberately sticky: moving the pointer off a chip does NOT reset it, and moving onto a DIFFERENT chip while the panel is open does NOT re-scope it. The panel must be closed with Escape before the next severity can be asserted — that is what the Escape steps below are for, not mere cleanup.

Read-only seeded data (no model call).

steps.label: load the app root
land on the PR list

guard: the home redirect landed on the demo repo — the seed holds TWO repos (acme/payments-api and xvivs/dev-digest) and ReposRepository.listByWorkspace has no ORDER BY, so which one `/` redirects to is not guaranteed by contract
PR list data settles

cmd: Migrate sessions table to UUID primary key
steps.label: open PR #479 by title, not by row position
navigate to the PR detail route
PR detail data settles
switch to the Agent runs tab
findings tab is active in the URL
the single seeded run renders one chip per severity present
hover the WARNING severity chip
the panel title names the severity and its count (plural)
exactly one panel is open — chips do not stack popovers

cmd: Rewrite locks the sessions table with no lock timeout
steps.label: panel body: first WARNING finding

cmd: Session lookup still parses the id as an integer
steps.label: panel body: second WARNING finding — the panel previews the whole severity set, not one row
move the pointer onto the panel itself
the panel survives the pointer leaving the chip and keeps its severity scope
close the panel — required before another severity can be scoped
Escape tears the panel down
hover the CRITICAL chip on a closed panel
the title re-scopes and switches to the singular noun
close the panel again
reach the SUGGESTION chip by keyboard instead of pointer
focus opens the same panel as hover — the preview is keyboard-reachable
